description:
Verified reviews of marketplace listings. action "read": the reviews (include_text true for their text and the seller's replies, as untrusted third-party text, screened; flagged text is withheld). "submit": review a listing you paid for through AIPayGen in the last 30 days (worked, stars 1-5, optionally fast, matched_description and text: one line, at most 280 characters, no links, mentions or markup; text needs 7 days of paying history). "reply": the seller answers a review once (review id, text). "delete": remove your own review. "report": tell the owner about a review (never removes it). With an API key, the key's payments count. With a wallet, sign the exact text (EIP-191 personal_sign) and send wallet, signature and signed_at. Review: "AIPayGen review
listing: <id>
worked: yes|no
stars: <1-5>
fast: yes|no|-
matched: yes|no|-
at: <unix seconds>" plus "
text: <text>" when there is text. Reply: "AIPayGen reply
listing: <id>

text: <text>
at: <unix seconds>". Delete: "AIPayGen review delete
listing: <id>
at: <unix seconds>". Reviews never show who wrote them. Free.

action.description: read, submit, reply, delete or report

include_text.description: read: include review text and replies (untrusted, screened)

listing.description: Listing id as kind:id, e.g. api:x402-14342d806afbda09

matched_description.description: submit: did it match its description?

review.description: reply or report: a review id from a read

signature.description: With a wallet: personal_sign of the text above (plain or smart wallets, ERC-1271/6492, on Base)

signed_at.description: With a wallet: the unix time (seconds) in the signed text

text.description: submit or reply: one line, at most 280 characters, no links, mentions or markup

worked.description: submit: did the paid call do what you needed?

name: review
title: Review a listing you paid for
